known_before_amendment: The four declared science/weight files retain their frozen checksums and 5000x5000 shapes.
Their primary WCS headers use the same nominal 0.065-arcsec pixel scale and aligned CD matrix.
A separate BCG-light PSF audit had already measured three catalog-selected stars; those three outcomes are disclosed but are not used to set the H1 detection thresholds.
No H1 detection catalog, matched-source count, affine residual, union segmentation map, H1 PSF-star count, arc centroid, lens residual, or gravity residual was measured.
engineering_amendment.reason: Protocol 0.1 required fixed morphology and saturation cuts but did not give executable numerical values. Version 0.2 supplies them before H1 pixel access without changing any scientific acceptance gate.

post_freeze_engineering_correction.trigger: The first H1 execution stopped during tiled-background construction before source detection because the implementation required at least 95 percent of all 128-pixel tiles to satisfy the per-tile 50-percent valid-pixel rule. That global 95-percent condition was not present in protocol 0.2 and is incompatible with the expected zero-weight mosaic perimeter.
post_freeze_engineering_correction.correction: Remove only the unintended global 95-percent tile requirement. Retain the frozen 50-percent per-tile rule, fill failed perimeter tiles from the nearest valid background tile solely for interpolation, and continue to require strictly positive WHT for every pixel used in detection or fitting.

post_detection_engineering_correction.known_v0_3_outcome: The invalid implementation found 39 mutual matches, 0.37856-arcsec cross-validated RMS, 526/612 successful F814W PSF fits, and 177/203 successful F125W fits. H1 failed and H2 remained locked.
post_detection_engineering_correction.WCS_trigger: Astropy reported inconsistent SIP information: SIP coefficients were present although the drizzled-image CTYPE values omit the -SIP suffix. Two false mutual matches with 10.44- and 31.86-pixel coordinate discrepancies dominated an otherwise approximately 0.01-arcsec residual distribution.
post_detection_engineering_correction.WCS_correction: For these distortion-corrected drizzled mosaics, set the Astropy WCS sip attribute to None whenever CTYPE omits -SIP; retain the frozen 0.3-arcsec mutual-nearest sky match and all affine acceptance thresholds.
post_detection_engineering_correction.PSF_trigger: The implementation bounded Moffat alpha scale radii to 1-8 pixels and then rejected the converted FWHM outside 1-8 pixels. Protocol 0.2 explicitly declared FWHM_bounds_pixels, so the code applied the bounds to the wrong parameters.
post_detection_engineering_correction.PSF_correction: Parameterize the Moffat fit directly by major and minor FWHM and apply the unchanged 1-8 pixel bounds to those declared parameters. Retain every source, the 90-percent successful-fit threshold, beta bounds, source cuts, and star-count gate.

purpose: Replace the fixed 0.5-arcsec lens-coordinate likelihood convention with a full 42x42 image-measurement/WCS covariance, without using a lens mass model, model residual, or gravity response.

registration.source_selection: Detect compact, unsaturated, non-edge sources independently in each band at >=20 total-flux S/N, match within 0.3 arcsec, and retain every match passing fixed morphology and saturation cuts.
registration.transform: six-parameter affine F125W-to-F814W mapping under a Student-t residual likelihood with 4 degrees of freedom
registration.rule: Refit the same transform in 500 matched-source bootstrap draws. No match may be added or removed by eye; if fewer than 20 matches pass, fail the branch.

H1_execution_freeze.weight_interpretation: The CLASH WHT image is inverse variance. A pixel is valid only when science and weight are finite and weight is strictly positive.

background.scale: 1.4826 times tile MAD with an inverse-weight median floor
background.interpolation: bilinear interpolation of tile centers to the science grid

compact_source_detection.total_flux_SNR_definition: sum of background-subtracted per-pixel standardized residuals inside radius 6 divided by the square root of the valid aperture-pixel count
compact_source_detection.saturation_rule: For ELECTRONS/S multiply by EXPTIME before applying the limit; also reject a source with two or more equal-valued central peak pixels.
compact_source_detection.rule: Detect independently in each band and retain every source passing all cuts; no ranking or manual deletion is allowed.

matching_and_affine_fit.model: F125W pixel coordinates to F814W pixel coordinates with six affine parameters
matching_and_affine_fit.solver: joint radial-residual IRLS, maximum 50 iterations, relative coefficient tolerance 1e-10
matching_and_affine_fit.cross_validation: leave one matched source out, refit on all remaining matches, and compute the RMS held-out sky residual

segmentation_implementation.standardization: subtract the frozen tiled background and multiply by sqrt(WHT) in each band; transform F125W onto F814W before summing and divide the sum by sqrt(2)

spatial_PSF.field_coordinates: x and y centered on 2499.5 and divided by 2500

union_segmentation_mask.detection_image: inverse-local-variance standardized sum of F814W and registered F125W
union_segmentation_mask.rule: Freeze one segmentation map before any arc centroid fit. Within each arc stamp, unmask only the connected component containing the published coordinate; mask all other components identically in both bands.

psf.source_rule: Use every isolated, unsaturated compact source passing the same registration morphology cuts, excluding a 3-arcsec radius around any ledger image.
psf.model: per-band spatially varying elliptical Moffat PSF with linear focal-plane variation of width and ellipticity
psf.fallback: No synthetic or borrowed PSF fallback is allowed. Fewer than 12 accepted stars fails the centroid branch before arc fitting.

centroid_model.source_model: three positive elliptical Gaussian components sharing one centroid, each with free amplitude, covariance, and scale, convolved with the frozen local PSF
centroid_model.background_model: tilted plane plus one band-specific constant
centroid_model.bootstrap: Use 3x3-pixel moving-block resampling of background residuals plus Poisson source noise and the per-band PSF bootstrap draw. Seeds are SHA-256(image_id|band|draw_index) truncated to 64 bits.
forbidden: moving a stamp after viewing a fit
relabeling or deleting a ledger image
using a lens model, critical curve, predicted image, or lens residual
using the previous fixed 0.5-arcsec convention as measurement noise

covariance.coordinate_order: ledger row order, [RA_east, Dec_north] for each of 21 images
covariance.combination: For each of 500 joint draws, draw the shared affine WCS solution and independent per-band centroid/bootstrap states, transform both bands to F814W, and precision-combine the two band centroids. Compute the sample covariance of the resulting 42-vectors.

stage_outcomes.outcome: >=20 registration matches, >=12 PSF stars, one frozen union segmentation mask, and 500 WCS draws.
stage_outcomes.advance_if: Registration cross-validated RMS <=0.12 arcsec and every checksum/mask/PSF gate passes.
stage_outcomes.rethink_if: Stop before arc fitting; do not borrow a mass model or synthetic error.

stage_outcomes.outcome: >=18 of 21 spectroscopic images, including 5.2, 6.3, and 8.2, pass independent two-band centroid gates.
stage_outcomes.advance_if: All accepted images satisfy cross-band, S/N, bootstrap, and per-coordinate uncertainty gates.
stage_outcomes.rethink_if: Retain the source ledger but do not claim measurement covariance.

stage_outcomes.outcome: One PSD 42x42 coordinate covariance in immutable ledger order, with off-diagonals only from shared measurement systematics.
stage_outcomes.advance_if: Authorize same-system observable-package assembly only after independent XMM X3 success.
stage_outcomes.rethink_if: Keep RX J2129 structural-only if the matrix or image-count gate fails.
